entries.20b84714fa75c6e0: As a holding company, it operates three businesses, watches, electronic devices and systems, through its subsidiaries, and earns revenue from product sales and services.
entries.29b2760fd3d6150a: The business handles watches (wristwatches) and their movements, clocks (table and wall clocks), and luxury jewelry, apparel and miscellaneous goods. In Japan, Seiko Watch Corporation handles wholesale, Chronos Co., Ltd. handles watch retail, Morioka Seiko Instruments Inc. handles manufacturing, and Wako Co., Ltd. handles retail of jewelry, apparel and miscellaneous goods; overseas, sales companies and manufacturing companies in each country take on these roles. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was the largest of the three businesses.
entries.3b8449497970bc94: Centered on Seiko Instruments Inc., it manufactures and sells electronic devices, including batteries and materials, crystal resonators, precision components, printers, and ICs for crystal oscillators.
